name: Runway
description: Runway builds AI models and creative tools for generating and editing video, image, and audio content, offering a cloud-based creative suite (Runway Creative) alongside a developer API (Runway Dev).
best_for: Individual creatives and design teams producing generated video and imagery, and software developers integrating AI media generation into their own products via API.
features: Text-to-video and image-to-video generation with the Gen-4.5 video model
Runway Creative, an all-in-one cloud-based creative suite for generation and editing
Runway Dev, an API platform for building custom AI media pipelines
Customizable workflow endpoints combining multiple models and tasks
Mobile apps for Android and iOS

alternatives.name: Synthesia
alternatives.description: An AI video platform focused on avatar-led, script-to-video content for business communication and training.
alternatives.best_for: Teams producing presenter-led training, sales, or marketing videos rather than generative/cinematic video.

alternatives.name: Midjourney
alternatives.description: An AI image and video generation tool centered on text-to-image prompting and stylized visuals.
alternatives.best_for: Creators wanting stylized, prompt-driven imagery rather than a full creative/API media suite.

alternatives.name: ElevenLabs
alternatives.description: An AI audio platform for voice generation, cloning, and conversational voice agents.
alternatives.best_for: Creators needing narration, dubbing, or voice agents to pair with generated video.
